# Toolnaut

> Toolnaut maps AI tools to the work someone actually does — their role, goal,
> budget and skill level — and shows why each tool fits. A 60-second quiz
> produces a personalised stack and a 4-week learning roadmap, drawn from a
> curated catalogue that a daily discovery pipeline keeps current.

Toolnaut exists because AI-tool directories list everything and personalise
nothing. Someone asking "which AI tool should I use for X" gets a ranked list
built from their own constraints, with the reasoning for each pick shown rather
than hidden.

## What it does

- **Role-aware recommendations.** A nine-question intake covers role, goal,
  experience, budget and time available. Tools are scored against that profile,
  not against a popularity ranking.
- **Stated reasoning.** Every recommendation carries why it was chosen. The
  confidence label grades the inputs — how much is known about the user and how
  deep the pool of well-fitting tools is — not the picks themselves.
- **A 4-week roadmap.** Discovery is followed by a guided path to actually
  learning the tools, with lessons and checkpoints.
- **A self-updating catalogue.** An automated radar monitors GitHub, Product
  Hunt, Hacker News and tech feeds daily, filters noise, and publishes genuine
  new tools into the live catalogue.

## Catalogue

Around 700 curated tools across six areas: code and development, design,
writing, data, automation, and learning. The catalogue is not exhaustive by
design — curation is the product, and an unfiltered directory of thousands is
the thing Toolnaut exists to replace.

## Pricing

Every plan is a **one-time payment**. Nothing auto-renews, no card is stored,
and no customer is charged a second time without going through checkout again.

- **Free trial** — 7 days, full access, no card required.
- **Student** — Rs 299 for 30 days.
- **Pro** — Rs 799 for 30 days.
- **Team** — Rs 4,999 for 30 days.
- **Founder** — Rs 29,999, one payment, never expires. A limited offer.

Prices are charged in Indian Rupees worldwide. Visitors outside India are shown
an approximate conversion alongside the rupee figure, never instead of it.

Refunds: a 7-day money-back guarantee, no reason required.

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Toolnaut is in public beta, built solo by an indie developer in India.
- Recommendations are scored by a transparent weighted model over role, budget,
  skill and features — not by an opaque LLM ranking. An LLM explains and
  compares; it does not decide the order.
- The catalogue is curated, not scraped wholesale. New tools are filtered before
  publication.
- Contact: info@toolnaut.xyz
